text:
maria-support: Customer reports 400 from /v1/rerank when sending candidates array with a null entry. Says it worked earlier, now started failing after a client patch.
ryan-devx: can you drop the raw payload + curl so we can repro? also which SDK/version? :mag_right:
customer logs attached (via ticket): 400 Bad Request - "items[0].candidates[1] must be object". No stack from client.
maria-support: here's minimal repro they sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "req-42",
      "query": "best picnic spots",
      "candidates": [
        null,
        {"id": "c1", "text": "Central Park"}
      ],
      "top_k": null
    }
  ]
}
```
curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  --data-binary @payload.json
```
(They mentioned sdk-js@2.4.1 in the ticket.)
james-backend: that payload is hitting our request schema validator. two problems: candidates contains `null` (we expect objects) and top_k must be integer. validator returns 400 with a fairly terse error.
ryan-devx: likely cause: sdk-js serializer is turning undefined/empty arrays into `null` in some code path. I've seen a bug where `topK` undefined maps to `top_k: null`. Can you confirm the client call?
maria-support: customer pasted their client call: `client.rerank({ items: [{ id: 'req-42', query: 'best picnic spots', candidates: [undefined, { id: 'c1', text: 'Central Park' }], topK: undefined }] })`
james-backend: yep, that will serialize to JSON with `null` entries. Our server will reject null candidates because we rely on candidate objects to extract `text`. We should return a friendlier error though.
deploy-bot: new request queued: infra-logs/req-42 for 1765439999
ryan-devx: immediate next steps: 1) maria - ask customer to sanitize payload client-side: filter out falsy candidates and omit top_k if unset. Provide example patch. 2) james - open a small server-side improvement ticket to make the 400 error message clearer (e.g., "candidates must be non-null objects; top_k must be integer"). 3) create an SDK bug issue against sdk-js@2.4.1 showing the reproduction.
maria-support: suggested quickfix to send to customer:
```js
// before send
const cleanItems = items.map(it => ({
  ...it,
  candidates: (it.candidates || []).filter(c => c && typeof c === 'object'),
}));
// only set top_k if defined and number
if (typeof it.top_k === 'number') payload.top_k = it.top_k;
```
maria-support: customer tried the clean filter and reports rerank now returns 200. they were blocked in prod.
james-backend: filing ENG-1257 to: a) surface clearer schema errors; b) add a unit test to reject null in candidates with explicit message; c) add telemetry to capture common malformed shapes.
ryan-devx: also adding a small SDK test to sdk-js repo to ensure undefined doesn't become literal null in array serialization. assign to eng-devx.
maria-support: ok i'll reply to customer with repro steps, the quickfix snippet, and link to the tracking tickets. tagging @james-backend @ryan-devx for followups. :white_check_mark:
